Name: Nathan, Prophet
Summary: Prophet to whom the word of God came concerning David's house, telling David he would not build the house.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 17:1; 1 Chronicles 17:3: Prophet to whom the word of God came concerning David's house, telling David he would not build the house.
LifeLesson: The mention of Nathan in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
